text:
Jess: Quick sync — final pass on website copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need to lock hero lines + what we call out in the benchmark cards, webinar CTA, and inbound routing before copy freeze tomorrow.
Mike: can we keep hero short: 'Reliable LLM inference, wherever you deploy.' then subline about latency & cost?
Priya: +1 on short hero. For benchmark cards we should call out: p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, and an example throughput (rps) for Dedicated. e.g., 'p95 latency 120ms, $X/1M tokens, 600 rps (dedicated burst)'.
Alex: For Private page we need to highlight KMS/HSM and audit logs. Also make a short blurb: 'VPC & on-prem options for regulated workloads.'
Nora: Webinar integration: main CTA on page should be 'Watch webinar — Production inference at scale' leading to registration. After registration, route HOT leads (company size >1000 or tagged enterprise) to AE queue, others to trial flows.
Jess: routing detail: is that HubSpot form + hidden field 'company_size' + routing via workflow? @Priya?
Priya: yes — HubSpot form w/ company_size dropdown. Workflows: if company_size in (1000+, enterprise) -> notify #sales-enterprise and create task; else -> send series: webinar recording -> quickstart guide -> invite to dedicated trial.
Mike: copy suggestion for three micro-CTAs near benchmark cards: 'See the full benchmark', 'Compare deployments', 'Get a demo'. Keep them as buttons, not links.
Alex: also add small inline example snippet (one-liner) for dev eyes: `curl https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1", "prompt":"hello"}'` after the hero — shows how fast it is.
Nora: webinar planning note: 3 panels: 1) latency & batching strategies, 2) cost optimizations (quant, caching), 3) rollout/rollbacks & reliability. We'll capture clips for social.
Jess: timeline: copy freeze EOD tomorrow -> design pass next morning -> QA on Friday. Who owns final Hosted hero? @Mike. Dedicated hero? @Alex. Private hero? @Priya.
Mike: I can take Hosted. Drafting now, will post in #marketing-briefs in 30m. :thumbsup:
Alex: I'll draft Dedicated and a single-sentence enterprise value prop.
Priya: taking Private and the benchmark copy. I'll add the HubSpot form fields to the doc.
comms-bot: Reminder: copy freeze scheduled for 2024-05-08 17:00 UTC. Automated snapshot of page copy will be taken at freeze.
Jess: awesome — I'll compile everything into the content checklist and ping design after your drafts. If anyone has short examples or competitor lines that we should avoid echoing, drop them here.
Mike: competitor note: avoid 'zero-latency' phrasing. Also don't claim 'cheapest' — focus on predictability & unit economics.
Nora: one more ask — add a short testimonial slot on each page: Hosted (startup), Dedicated (scale SaaS), Private (regulated fintech). I'll pull quotes from CS.
Jess: perfect. Thanks team — expect the compiled doc in ~1 hour. :rocket:
